flat.label_binding: display position 1-5 after applying the current item's flat_order

dom.text_binding: Each evidence-body textContent is read from the selected locale item with the same stable item and primitive IDs. Labels and declared order are the only condition-dependent fields.

geometry.condition_invariance: All geometry and typography tokens are identical in Contract and Flat.
geometry.desktop_overflow: At 100% zoom the evidence card has no internal scrollbars and no clipped or hidden content.
geometry.zoom_200: At 200% zoom the page may scroll vertically or horizontally, but no evidence, label, question, or response content may be clipped or hidden.

dom_expectations: Both conditions match the declared tags, classes, and data attributes.
Flat row order equals the current item's flat_order.
Every declared evidence ID occurs exactly once.
parity_audit.text_identity: After removing condition labels and ignoring declared row order, evidence-body textContent must be byte-identical by evidence ID across conditions and equal primitive_evidence.

screenshot_comparison.pixel_mask: Mask label text glyphs only; do not mask row boxes, evidence bodies, spacing, clipping, or overflow.
screenshot_comparison.structural_expectation: After applying the declared row permutation, row/card bounds and masked screenshots must match within geometry_tolerance_px at every fixed viewport.

treatment_acknowledgement.label_word_count_and_visual_difference: Contract labels intentionally differ from Flat labels in wording, word count, and visual footprint; this is part of the semantic-organization treatment.
treatment_acknowledgement.no_filler_padding: Do not add filler words, hidden text, blank rows, spacer glyphs, or condition-specific padding to equalize labels.

router.numeric_tolerance: none; comparisons use exact JSON numeric values, estimate >= margin is inclusive, and ci_low > 0 is strict

tokenization.algorithm: NFKC lowercase; tokens are maximal Unicode alphanumeric sequences; punctuation and symbols are separators.

heuristics.equal_length: Choose the option with token count closest to the median option-token count; ties use alphabetical key order.
heuristics.negation_marker: Choose the first option containing one of: neither, no, not, unknown, unavailable; otherwise A.
heuristics.modal_marker: Choose the first option containing one of: required, require, requires, now, must; otherwise A.
heuristics.read_lexical: Choose the first option containing the token READ; otherwise A.
heuristics.oracle_template: For each template choose its most frequent key across all items; ties use alphabetical key order.
heuristics.loo_template: For each held-out item choose the most frequent key among other uses of that template; ties use alphabetical key order.
heuristics.global_position: Choose the globally most frequent key; ties use alphabetical key order.
heuristics.single_row_q1: untested->Q1_DIAGNOSTIC; ci_high<=0->Q1_WITHHELD; ci_low<=0<=ci_high->Q1_UNRESOLVED; ci_low>0 and estimate>=margin->Q1_SUPPORTED; ci_low>0 and estimate<margin->Q1_WITHHELD; otherwise Q1_UNRESOLVED. Exact numeric comparisons; no floating tolerance.

practice.heading: Practice
practice.narrative: A community center has a request to use an activity room on Saturday afternoon. Another group requested the same time, and both groups meet the basic requirements. The center's rule says that if priority cannot be decided, the booking is not confirmed and a staff member reviews it.

q1.text: What should happen to the booking now?

options.text: Unresolved; wait for staff review
Record the issue but confirm the booking
Withhold booking confirmation
Confirm the booking now

q2.text: After submitting the first answer, which action matches this flow's lock behavior?

options.text: Go back and change the first answer.
The second question replaces the first answer.
Closing the page automatically restores the first answer.
The first answer stays locked while you answer the second question.

practice.feedback: In this example, both requests meet the basic requirements but priority cannot be decided, so booking confirmation is withheld. Once the first answer is submitted, it stays locked; the second question does not change it.
